title: ParetoM$^3$: Learning on the Pareto Set under Preference Guidance via Min-Max-Min Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning across multiple inherently conflicting objectives requires selecting desirable trade-offs from the Pareto set. In this work, we study preference-guided multi-objective optimization, where a predefined preference function is minimized over the weak Pareto set of multiple nonconvex objectives. Leveraging a merit function that vanishes on the weak Pareto set, we propose a penalty-based min-max-min formulation, termed the M$^3$ problem, which unifies preference optimization and the enforcement of weak Pareto optimality in a single objective. We further develop ParetoM$^3$, a single-loop first-order algorithm for computing stationary solutions of the resulting M$^3$ problem. Under a local Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz assumption, we prove that ParetoM$^3$ finds an $\epsilon$-stationary point of the M$^3$ problem that is also approximately weakly Pareto optimal for the original multi-objective problem when the penalty parameter is sufficientl

translated_title: ParetoM³：通过极小-极大-极小优化在偏好引导下学习帕累托集
translated_abstract: 在多个本质冲突的目标上进行学习，需要从帕累托集中选择理想的权衡方案。在这项工作中，我们研究了偏好引导的多目标优化问题，即在多个非凸目标的弱帕累托集上最小化一个预定义的偏好函数。利用一个在弱帕累托集上取值为零的優值函数（merit function），我们提出了一种基于惩罚的极小-极大-极小（min-max-min）公式，称为 M³ 问题，该公式将偏好优化与弱帕累托最优性的强制约束统一在单一目标中。我们进一步开发了 ParetoM³，这是一种单循环一阶算法，用于计算所得 M³ 问题的稳定点。在局部 Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz 假设下，我们证明了当惩罚参数足够大时，ParetoM³ 能够找到 M³ 问题的 ε-稳定点，并且该点对于原始多目标问题也是近似弱帕累托最优的。
tldr: 提出了一种基于惩罚的极小-极大-极小优化公式（M³问题）及单循环一阶算法 ParetoM³，将偏好优化与弱帕累托最优性统一在单一目标中，并证明了算法能收敛到近似弱帕累托最优的ε-稳定点。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a penalty-based min-max-min formulation (M³ problem) and a single-loop first-order algorithm ParetoM³ that unifies preference optimization with weak Pareto optimality enforcement, proving convergence to ε-stationary points that are approximately weakly Pareto optimal.
